ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is characterized by a contiguous low-intensity field with localized high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered linear high-intensity vectors distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression; while the deepest pixel vertex is partially occluded by water turbulence, the converging linear edges indicate a shallow, wide-angled notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits a more jagged pixel-amplitude variation compared to the smoother, more worn topography of the left lobe's medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes, exhibiting an increasing upward curvature at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme distal margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); specifically, four distinct vertical/diagonal lines on the left lobe and scattered horizontal/diagonal disruptions on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips and significant rake-mark scarring across the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-intensity white triangular focal patch is visible at the central intersection of the fluke lobes near the median notch.
